name: NEWC Heavyweight Championship
caption: The promotion's top singles championship, announced at its debut show and left vacant through a qualifying tournament.
epitaph: Announced at the promotion's own debut show as its top singles title, to be crowned in a Four Corners match at the federation's first supercard, and still vacant through a qualifying tournament in every broadcast this collection preserves.

name: NEWC Television Championship
caption: The promotion's secondary singles championship, crowned in a ten-man battle royal at the federation's second show.
epitaph: Crowned in a ten-man main-event battle royal at the promotion's second broadcast, won by Sabbath, who carried it through both defenses this collection preserves.

name: NEWC Tri-State Championship
caption: A regional championship created for the promotion's own New Jersey, New York and Connecticut roster, announced with a tournament still underway.
epitaph: Created to represent the New Jersey, New York and Connecticut area the promotion's own roster is drawn from, announced with a tournament to crown its first champion that remains underway when this collection's own record ends.
